origin.note: Rounded WGS84 point near slip B-12; chosen for readability, not a surveyed control point.

frame.axes: east (+x scene), north (−z scene), up (+y scene)
frame.projection: Local tangent plane: equirectangular with WGS84 meridian/prime-vertical radii at origin latitude. Few-cm error over the working area; not a survey datum.

provenance_note: Headwalks, river centreline and OSM polygons: DOC (OpenStreetMap, ODbL, fetched 2026-11-14) — documented source, not current survey. Slips: ASSUME (generated). Masses, bank, land masks and map-derived features: ASSUME (digitized from the 1 June 2022 ESD site map via a 3-anchor similarity fit; ±10 m).

anchors.name: Dock A headwalk NW end ↔ headwalk at the 2022 site-boundary corner (map marker 2)
Gap between Dock B’s two runs ↔ gangway at map marker 5
Dock E headwalk SE end ↔ dock line end in the Skyway shadow (map marker 10)

independentChecks.name: Mid-river on the map (between Canalside wharf edge and the dock line at x=850 px) vs OSM river centreline

independentChecks.verdict: unresolved — identification of the map channel is uncertain; north-bank context stays approximate

mapFit.note: Similarity transform local metres → 2400-px render (y up). Used only to place approximate context.

waterStrategy: Water is a plane at sea level. Land masks are drawn only where land evidence exists. Partial OSM water polygons are never closed across the site.

landMasks.basis: Marina side. North of the canal mouth: bank authored 1 m (Dock A) / 3 m (Dock B first run) behind the OSM headwalks. South-east of the mouth: the City Ship Canal west edge (DOC, OSM 31752570). Closes 400 m inland.
Peninsula between the City Ship Canal and the river: canal east edge (DOC, OSM 31752570) + river bank assumed 45 m from the OSM centreline
Canalside side: wharf edge digitized from the 2022 map, extended; closes inland
